name: ClueWeb Crawler
description: The crawler that builds the CMU ClueWeb research corpus, run by Professor Chenyan Xiong's research group at Carnegie Mellon's Language Technologies Institute and used for language-model research. The operator documents that it crawls only public unauthenticated pages and content permitted by robots.txt, rate-limits per host, backs off on 429 and 503 responses, and offers an opt-out form in addition to robots.txt. It says its requests come from CMU SCS addresses but publishes no ranges, so they cannot be verified.
